fact: Africa24 TV says the Msaanda social cash transfers under the World Bank-financed PFSS-RRC (2023-2027) pay each beneficiary up to 75,000 KMF via mobile banking, reaching 40,010 households.

The World Bank/Government mission aide-memoire on the PFSS-RRC social safety net project says the use of electronic payments, with digitalised operations and a digitised monitoring system, contributed to the success of the project's interventions.
The PFSS-RRC says the World Bank-backed Mayendeleyo social cash transfer phase launched on 20 September 2026 pays 55,000 households through the mobile-banking operators Mvula and Huri Money.
